name: Marionette
ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]
setup: Remove the Marionette token and add a Townsfolk token instead (if three Minions would be in play, also replace a Minion with a Townsfolk). A good player neighbouring the Demon becomes the Marionette and believes they are their good character.
wakes: Never as the Marionette. Wakes when their believed good character would; the Demon is woken on the first night to be shown who the Marionette is.
interaction: The Marionette is told nothing about being evil and skips Minion info. The Demon is shown the Marionette (the player and the Marionette token) on the first night.
drunk_or_poisoned: No observable change: the Marionette has no ability of its own beyond setup and the Demon's knowledge, which are already done. Their believed good ability never works regardless.

jinxes.text: An Alchemist-Marionette has no Marionette ability & the Marionette is in play.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, an Outsider might have been added during setup.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added during setup.
If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
If the Magician is alive, the Demon doesn't know which neighbor is the Marionette.
The Mathematician learns if the Marionette's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
If the Storyteller would gain the Marionette ability, one of the Demon's good neighbors becomes the Marionette.

rulings.text: The Marionette registers as evil and as a Minion while believing they are a good character.
The Marionette must sit directly next to the Demon.
The Marionette does not learn the evil team and other Minions do not learn the Marionette.
Treat the Marionette like a Drunk: their good ability does not work and they may receive false information.
Abilities that would reveal Minion status (Snitch, Preacher, Poppy Grower, Damsel, etc.) do not wake the Marionette.

test_scenarios.name: setup and demon knowledge
test_scenarios.setup: Seats in order: Mia Imp, Ned (Marionette, believes Undertaker), Ola Chef, Pat Empath, Quin Monk, Rex Poisoner
test_scenarios.expected: Ned is shown Undertaker; Ned gets no Minion info; Mia is shown Ned as the Marionette; Rex does not learn Ned.

test_scenarios.name: false info
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Ola (Chef) executed. Night 2: Ned wakes as Undertaker.
test_scenarios.expected: Ned may be shown any character (Storyteller chooses, e.g. Imp); the info is not guaranteed true.

test_scenarios.name: registers evil
test_scenarios.setup: Mia Imp, Ned Marionette (believes Monk), Ola Empath (seated next to Ned), Pat Chef, Quin Soldier
test_scenarios.actions: First night: Ola Empath reads her neighbours Ned and Pat.
test_scenarios.expected: Ola's truthful count includes Ned as evil (1).

test_scenarios.name: poisoned marionette
test_scenarios.setup: Mia Imp, Ned Marionette (believes Soldier), Rex Poisoner, Pat Chef, Quin Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Rex poisons Ned; Mia attacks Ned.
test_scenarios.expected: Ned dies: the Soldier protection never worked; poisoning changes nothing.

test_scenarios.name: magician jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Mia Imp, Ned Marionette, Ola Magician, Pat Chef, Quin Empath (Mia neighbours Ned and Pat)
test_scenarios.expected: Mia is not told which neighbour is the Marionette.
